posts.cooked: In line 14 when you are writing print(x,y,z) you are putting commas between them but python consider the spaces by default so if you want them to be separated by commas then you should write print(x,y,z, sep=’, ‘) (Note: There is a space after comma in ‘sep’ because that’s what expected output desires) or you can try with f string as well to get the same result.
